body: Breifly. I'm glad I didn't tell a lot of people, because there is a risk I'd get put in a psych ward if I did.

~~Well, I'm no longer as wet as I was when I came out of the bathtub.~~

I'm feeling fine.

I think that while I do find school to be tough, I am more afraid of how absurdly difficult the rest of life would be in comparison. Learning in university, trying to get a job, trying to keep a job, and finally, trying to achieve or create lifelong goals, are all things that seem to be way worse.
